{"consolidated_memory":"Plan drift in infra/terraform/vpc.tf VPC module: TWO SEPARATE OCCASIONS

OCCASION 1 - [2026-06-21]
File: infra/terraform/vpc.tf
Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
Problem: plan drift in the VPC module
Signal: diff on a resource nobody edited
Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
PR: #7340 on branch fix/plan-drift-4
Repro steps: run plan twice with no changes in between
Stack: HCL
Covering check: terraform plan check in CI
Result: reclaimed 34 GB of blob storage

OCCASION 2 - [2026-08-05]
File: infra/terraform/vpc.tf
Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Problem: plan drift in the VPC module
Signal: diff on a resource nobody edited
Root cause: a listener registered but never removed
Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
PR: #8065 on branch fix/plan-drift-5
Repro steps: run plan twice with no changes in between
Stack: HCL
Covering check: terraform plan check in CI
Result: memory settled at 271 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB

Pattern: Both occasions manifested identical signal (unexplained resource diff), but had distinct root causes and triggers. Both fixed via targeted code changes with CI test coverage. Both verified by repeating plan runs."}
